info.name: Taskbook
info.summary: Taskbook is a Nextcloud app for managing tasks, plans, and notes in one simple daily workspace.
info.description:
Taskbook brings tasks, planning, and notes together in a calm, Nextcloud-native interface. Inspired by concepts from the Bullet Journal® method, it focuses on quick capture, a chronological daily log, and lightweight organization without trying to reproduce the method exactly.
Tasks, ideas, notes, and plans can be recorded quickly without interrupting your workflow. Entries for the current day remain visible in one place, including completed tasks, so the daily log also serves as a complete record of the day.
Quick entry, keyboard shortcuts, dashboard integration, and a clean chronological view make everyday organization fast and unobtrusive.
Taskbook is an independent application and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Bullet Journal or Lightcage LLC.
info.author: Florian Steffens
